messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] SEV2 — p99 latency spike detected for model redwood-open-1 (us-west2). Auto-paging oncall. Signals: streaming stalls, increased tail latency, elevated KV cache misses. Monitoring runbook: /runbooks/latency-tail.
Maya Patel: seeing the same in the dashboard — p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms and p99 is spiking to 1.1s for streaming endpoints. Affected customer: ACME Corp (subset of traffic). Correlation: we kicked an int8 calibration profile rollout at 03:10 (calib-id: c-20260315-03).
Jordan (oncall): I'm on it, taking primary. @Oliver @Samir can you join? I'll start paging SRE rotation. Moving thread to paging-ops but keeping discussion here for context.
Oliver Chen: joining. Quick look: KV cache miss rate for long-context (>4096) shows a 6x increase. Also seeing a lot of dequantization warnings in runtime logs: "dequant_kv_stride_mismatch" and a handful of OOM-like stalls (no kernel OOM, but thread stalls). Dump snippet:
```
[03:14:12] model=redwood-open-1 calib=c-20260315-03 dequant_warn: kv_stride mismatch: expected 128 got 120
[03:14:12] runtime: stream_write stall 450ms pid=4821 tid=0x7f2a
[03:14:13] cache: miss_rate 0.38 -> 0.72 for seq>4096
```
Samir R: that calib id is the new aggressive int8 profile that enabled mixed-precision kv packing to squeeze activations. We saw perf gains in short-context evals but I flagged long-context tests to be flaky — maybe rollout gate didn't cover long-context tail. Suspect incorrect scale/zero-point mapping for some layers causing extra memcpy/dequant work and KV fragmentation.
Leah Nguyen: customer impact: CS Ops says ACME is seeing retry/reconnect behavior on streaming endpoints — some calls are being retried by their client, leading to degraded experience. No data loss, but UX is bad. They reported at 03:18.
CS Ops: Confirmed — ACME chat streams have frequent reconnects, they escalated to support on their side. Preparing a short notification: "We detected increased latency affecting streaming; mitigation in progress."
Jordan (oncall): immediate mitigation plan:
1) Pause/rollback calibration rollout c-20260315-03 and fall back that model variant to previous calibration (c-20260308-21).
2) Reroute ACME traffic to fp16 variant or previous profile for affected endpoints.
3) If rollback doesn't normalize within 10m, scale up dedicated pool for ACME and enable fallback routing rule.
Who's able to run the rollback? Need API/infra to revert calib quickly.
Maya Patel: I can call the control plane, but need exact command. Also need to ensure no restart of serving processes to avoid more churn.
Oliver Chen: use the rollout API with preserve-kv flag = true (we want to avoid clearing KV cache to minimize coldstart). Command:
```
# rollback calibration for model redwood-open-1 in us-west2
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/models/redwood-open-1/rollouts/rollback \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RP_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"from_calib":"c-20260315-03","to_calib":"c-20260308-21","preserve_kv":true}'
```
Oliver Chen: I'll run this now; patching set to run across edge routers. Logging output shows rollout request id r-98765.
IncidentBot: rollback request r-98765 accepted, started staged rollback across us-west2 nodes. Estimated completion: 60-120s.
Jordan (oncall): monitor p99 and streaming stall count. @Samir can you watch model logs for dequant warns to confirm decline?
Samir R: watching. Early signs: dequant_warn rate dropping in the next 30s. KV miss rate also starting to trend down.
Maya Patel: p95 back to ~140ms and p99 trending down to ~320ms at 03:16:45. Streaming stall counts decreased by ~70% for ACME routed hosts.
CS Ops: Sending customer update: "We observed an internal model calibration rollout that impacted streaming latency for a subset of requests. We've rolled back the calibration for your tenant and are monitoring. No user data affected. ETA for resolution: minutes. Contact: support@redwood.com."
Leah Nguyen: ACME acknowledged and is monitoring from their side, they see fewer reconnects now.
Jordan (oncall): ok mitigation looks effective. Next actions while we keep paging:
- Confirm rollback fully propagated and no regressions for short-context paths (Samir + Oliver).
- Run a canary long-context workload against the rolled-back profile to validate tail stability (Samir).
- Prepare a post-incident action item list: add long-context gating to calibration rollout, add canary with KV fragmentation detection, improve auto-rollback thresholds for streaming stalls.
Oliver Chen: adding an immediate temporary policy: block auto-rollouts for calib profiles that enable "mixed_kv_packing" unless long-context tests pass. I'll open an internal PR.
Samir R: repro plan: run 1k long-context synthetic streams with mixed tokens and measure dequant_warns and kv_miss rate. I'll run on a dev pool and share results.
Maya Patel: filing incident ticket INC-20260315-4781 with notes, timeline, and initial mitigation. Assigning follow-ups to Samir (root cause + repro), Oliver (rollout gating), Leah (customer comms), and Jordan (postmortem).
IncidentBot: SEV2 incident status -> mitigated. p99 returned below SLO threshold for affected routes. Incident will remain open for follow-up items. Auto-create follow-up issues: true.
Leah Nguyen: quick customer note drafted for postmortem: "Root cause: a calibration profile with aggressive int8 KV packing was rolled out without sufficient long-context validation. Cause led to increased dequant work and KV fragmentation, causing stalls at the tail for streaming requests. Remediation: rollback applied and rollout gated; full postmortem to follow."
Jordan (oncall): thanks everyone — handing to oncall-handoff: @Maya will retain ownership for the next 2 hours while follow-ups are tracked. If anything spikes, re-page SRE rotation.
Maya Patel: acknowledged, keeping watch and will update INC ticket with timeline and logs.
CS Ops: ACME support says the customer is satisfied with the update and will await postmortem. Marking customer notify: yes.
Samir R: preliminary hypothesis recorded in INC-20260315-4781: bug in mixed-precision kv packing mapping introduced misaligned strides for certain layer shapes — leads to extra dequant memcpy and cache fragmentation. I'll attach failing tensor shapes and tests.
Oliver Chen: created PR #4321 to add long-context gate and KV-frag metric to rollout evaluator.
Maya Patel: closing the active paging channel. Leaving incident open for follow-ups. TL;DR: rollback of int8 calib profile fixed p99 tail; customer impacted (ACME) notified; follow-ups assigned.
Leah Nguyen: postmortem owner assigned to Maya. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (oncall): handing off to next SRE — @Maya will continue updates. :thumbsup:
__notes: Document follows agents.md: single-thread Slack export style, messages as a continuous string with sender prefixes. No title field included.
